subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world multi-step word problems modeled by quadratic functions (projectile motion, area optimization), using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student models a realistic scenario (a thrown object's path, a maximized area) using a quadratic equation
exercise.pictorial: Student graphs the scenario before interpreting the solution's real-world meaning
exercise.abstract: Student solves a real-world quadratic word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: finds a mathematically valid solution that doesn't make sense in the real-world context (e.g. negative time)

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
